title: AIは頭を使わなくなる、と言われるが、以前より頭を使っている
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished, premium Japanese YouTube thumbnail, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is the thumbnail for a kinetic-typography essay video titled exactly 「AIは頭を使わなくなる、と言われるが、以前より頭を使っている」. The attached reference image is a SCENE AND PALETTE reference, not an image to reproduce unchanged. Preserve the recognizable plain wooden desk, one brass desk lamp, warm off-white and pale warm-grey tiled floor, softly illuminated patches. No humans.

Art direction: striking editorial Japanese typography meets cinematic miniature architecture, bright warm paper background #fbf8f1, near-black ink #1e2430, confident burnt orange #e87800. Refined and boldly graphic, immediately readable at phone size. Show the desk and lamp in the upper-right portion, surrounded by an expanding irregular field of softly lit floor tiles that recedes in perspective; blend the image cleanly into the paper background on the left. The implication is curiosity and thinking expanding into unfamiliar territory, not brain damage. No brain illustrations, robots, circuits, question marks, arrows, logos, badges or extra slogans.

The full title must be typeset accurately, and ONLY the following Japanese text should appear, exactly once, in this reading order with these line breaks:
AIは頭を使わなくなる、
と言われるが、
以前より
頭を使っている

Typography and composition: the first two lines are substantial but secondary, set near the upper left in heavy clean Japanese Gothic; “と言われるが、” can be a little smaller. The last two lines are the dominant headline occupying the lower-left and lower-center of the frame. “以前より” is very large near-black, “頭を使っている” is the strongest oversized burnt-orange line, with dense, beautiful spacing and rock-solid readable glyph shapes. Ensure the entire last line fits without clipping, with generous edge safety margins (at least 5% of the frame) and free of the bottom-right YouTube duration overlay area. Integrate the architectural scene into the negative space on the upper-right and behind the headline without reducing text contrast. Do not add fake distressed glyphs, outlined sticker type, decorative sparkles, excessive elements, small unreadable copy, English captions or watermarks. Preserve both Japanese commas and every character of the exact title. Design should feel like a sophisticated, energetic book-cover poster adapted to YouTube, with dramatic type scale and clean visual hierarchy. Deliver the final thumbnail image, not a mockup or a screen.
export: JPEG exported at 1280x720; original generated PNG preserved. No artistic changes after generation.
